mechanism: Chlorthalidone may cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia, which can increase oseltamivir neuropsychiatric adverse effects; oseltamivir is renally cleared and thiazide diuretics may reduce renal function over time.
action: Monitor electrolytes periodically, especially potassium and sodium levels; assess renal function baseline and periodically; consider alternative antiviral if significant electrolyte abnormalities develop.
